issue.title: Ctrl+Shift+O forward jump arrives as Ctrl+O under tmux and jumps backward
issue.description:
The app-level forward jump `jump_to_entry_forward` defaults to `ctrl+shift+o` (src/sase/default_config.yml:746, bindings.py:23). Under tmux 3.5a -- the terminal chain every live `sase tui` runs in on athena (kitty -> ssh -> tmux, `extended-keys off`) -- Ctrl+Shift+<letter> is delivered to Textual as plain Ctrl+<letter>. Pressing "forward jump" therefore fires `jump_to_entry_fast` (`ctrl+o`, backward): the wrong action, not a no-op.

Root cause: tmux 3.5a normalizes Ctrl+Shift+letter to Ctrl+letter even with `extended-keys always` + `extended-keys-format csi-u` + `terminal-features xterm*:extkeys`; the same config passes Shift+Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Ctrl+; through as CSI-u. So no tmux configuration makes the binding reachable; the default key itself must change (or gain a reachable twin). Docs (docs/ace.md:194,330,988,1298,3198,4802; docs/artifact_links.md:168) advertise Ctrl+Shift+O.

Found during card-blocks research (research:202609/agent_data_card_blocks__cld.md, Appendix A), which also concludes Ctrl+Shift+J/K cannot be used for the proposed card-block keys for the same reason.

task_type_fields.impact: Every user running sase tui inside tmux (the default athena setup) gets a backward jump when pressing the advertised forward-jump key; forward jump is unreachable.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Start a private tmux server running a Textual key logger: `tmux -L probe -f /dev/null new-session -d -s p "<venv>/bin/python keyprobe.py"` where keyprobe.py logs `events.Key.key`.
2. `tmux -L probe send-keys -t p C-S-o` then `C-o`: both log `key='ctrl+o'`.
3. For raw client input, set `extended-keys always`, `extended-keys-format csi-u`, `terminal-features 'xterm*:extkeys'`, attach a client in a pty with TERM=xterm-kitty and write `\x1b[106;6u` / `\x1b[27;6;106~` (Ctrl+Shift+J): the pane receives `\n`. `\x1b[13;2u` (Shift+Enter) arrives intact, proving extended keys are otherwise on.
4. In a live `sase tui` inside tmux, walk the link trail back with Ctrl+O, then press Ctrl+Shift+O: it walks further back instead of forward.

payload.description: Sibling terminal key-encoding defect: modifier+letter bindings mis-delivered under tmux/CSI-u; a shared audit of shifted/ctrl-shifted defaults may fix both
